# `Q-2-13` — Unclosed Strong Star Emphasis

> A `**strong**` run opens with `**` but no closing `**` appears
> before the end of the block.

## What this means

Double-star strong emphasis (`**text**`) must be balanced inside
the same block. This error fires when an opening `**` appears
without a matching close before the block ends.

## Why this happens

A typo, an unclosed sentence mid-edit, or a deletion that removed
the closing `**` but left the opener.

## How to fix

Add the closing `**` at the intended end, or escape literal
asterisks if you intended them as plain characters.

## Example

```markdown
**
```
